title: ficus fistulosa f. benguetensis
intro: Ficus fistulosa f. benguetensis, commonly known as Benguet banyan, is a plant species belonging to the Moraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever. The health benefits of Ficus fistulosa f. benguetensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, ulcers, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
